lines.speaker: sin
lines.text: Instructor! ((((((> <))))))

lines.speaker: sin
lines.text: Guilty and I are hatching up one heck of a scheme.

lines.speaker: sin
lines.text: You want in?
What does this so-called "scheme" entail?

lines.speaker: sin
lines.text: Hehe...

lines.speaker: sin
lines.text: Let me tell you...
... Sin doesn't reply for a while.

lines.speaker: sin
lines.text: Whoops, sorry!

lines.speaker: sin
lines.text: I was talking with Guilty.

lines.speaker: sin
lines.text: Have you ever heard of giving out free hugs?
Yes.
Sure, it's when people stand on the street and offer hugs to passersby.

lines.speaker: sin
lines.text: Yep! I figured you would know.

lines.speaker: sin
lines.text: Most people are a bit apprehensive

lines.speaker: sin
lines.text: about ex-inmates who have just been released from the Rehabilitation Center.

lines.speaker: sin
lines.text: Guilty and I figured that if we go around giving people hugs,

lines.speaker: sin
lines.text: it might help change any preconceptions people have about us.
You two aren't up to anything nefarious, are you?

lines.speaker: sin
lines.text: Hmm?
... Sin doesn't reply for a while.
Sin？

lines.speaker: sin
lines.text: Oh, hey!

lines.speaker: sin
lines.text: Actually, the whole giving out hugs thing wasn't our first idea.

lines.speaker: sin
lines.text: We figured that since you wouldn't discriminate against any ex-inmates,

lines.speaker: sin
lines.text: you'd feel the same way about our plan, and we wanted to get your thoughts on it.

lines.speaker: sin
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: sin
lines.text: So maybe in the end, free hugs are the way to go.

lines.speaker: sin
lines.text: Thank you for enlightening us, Instructor. Extra points for you!!!
Wait a minute.

lines.speaker: sin
lines.text: What?
Guilty's "hugs" could end up crushing someone.

lines.speaker: sin
lines.text: Haha.

lines.speaker: sin
lines.text: I know that.

lines.speaker: sin
lines.text: In the name of overcoming prejudice, that's a risk we'll have to take.
Wouldn't it be better if you...

lines.speaker: sin
lines.text: This way, it adds a little excitement to the mix.
I think you'd be better off coming up with an alternative plan.
... Sin doesn't reply for a while.

lines.speaker: sin
lines.text: Maybe.

lines.speaker: sin
lines.text: But we've already started making preparations.

lines.speaker: sin
lines.text: It'd be a shame to give up now.

lines.speaker: sin
lines.text: Plus, now that I've heard you out, Instructor,

lines.speaker: sin
lines.text: we're back on track.

lines.speaker: sin
lines.text: Actually, Guilty wants to stick to the original plan, too.
And what would that be?

lines.speaker: sin
lines.text: She'll be delighted to know that you agree.

lines.speaker: sin
lines.text: So if we were to quit now...
Wait, what's the original plan?

lines.speaker: sin
lines.text: Guilty will give everyone a great big bear hug!
... And then what?

lines.speaker: sin
lines.text: I'll gather 10 people and get back to you tomorrow morning.

lines.speaker: sin
lines.text: Get ready to have fun, Instructor!!!! ((((> <))))

lines.speaker: sin
lines.text: Hehehe

lines.speaker: sin
lines.text: Hahahahahaha
